title: Studying Disinformation Narratives on Social Media with LLMs and Semantic Similarity

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating cosine similarity between social media posts (e.g., from Donald Trump) and a target political disinformation narrative ('The 2020 election was stolen') to trace the frequency of the narrative over time, and comparing the frequency of specific narratives between right-leaning and left-leaning news outlets.

Measuring the semantic similarity of tweets from four major news outlets to the anti-trans target narrative 'Transgender people are harmful to society', filtering tweets above a similarity threshold, and using K-means clustering combined with an LLM to synthesize and characterize the dominant anti-trans narratives.
